desc:
🚂 TRAIN vs 🚗 CAR vs ✈️ PLANE 💥 Ver 1.2

Smash, crash and derail your way to the top! Every vehicle is built from breakable blocks, and the more pieces you break, the more cash you earn!

🚆 TRAINS: Drive real trains on a giant railway. Flip the switches, take a curve too fast to DERAIL, launch off the Train Jump and cause epic head-on crashes!
🚗 CARS: Drive cars, trucks, buses and tanks with real physics and ram everything in sight!
✈️ PLANES: Fly biplanes, fighter jets, bombers, giant passenger jets and the Concorde. Nosedive for MEGA crashes, or fly for 30 seconds and land safely for a bonus!
📦 PLACE cars on the tracks and watch the trains smash them for cash!

⭐ 60+ vehicles to unlock
⬆️ Upgrade speed and power
📜 Daily quests, levels and daily rewards
🤸 Funny ragdolls
📸 Hide the UI to take epic pictures
🎮 Play on PC, phone, tablet and console

👍 Like and ⭐ favorite for new vehicles and updates!
